panels.title: Stock Intel: Backfill
panels.body: Manual, run once after seeding the watchlist or after adding tickers. Pulls two years of daily bars for every active ticker (Alpaca, ~505 bars each, paginated) and computes indicators for all of them (days_back=600). Safe to re-run: every write is an upsert. Takes a few minutes.

zones.title: Trigger + run context
zones.body: Manual run, or a POST webhook on stock-intel/backfill carrying {tickers:[...]} so adding a ticker in the app backfills just that symbol. One SQL opens a run row and returns the active watchlist; Build context (2y) narrows to the webhook list when there is one and sets a two-year window, days_back=600.

zones.title: Collect
zones.body: Same sub-workflows the Daily run uses. Ctx re-emits the context item between them.

zones.title: Finish
zones.body: Closes intel.runs with the row counts from both sub-workflows.
